info.name: Habit Tracker API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Habit Tracker backend (C# + PostgreSQL).

HOW TO USE:
1. Run 'Register User' (or 'Login User' if already registered) first - this auto-saves your login token.
2. Then use any request in the 'Habits' folder - the token gets attached automatically, no copy-paste needed.
3. If you get a 401 Unauthorized error anywhere, it just means your token expired or you haven't logged in yet - just re-run Login.

Fetches one habit by id. habitId is auto-filled from 'Create Habit' above, or you can paste one manually.
